page.layout: One text column, running from the running head down to the centred final word "gnans." Below it, at left, a signature "E 2"; at right, the catchword "EXER-". No marginal notes.

main_text.p: bi[?],aut tardius,prout natura quęuis est mor-bi concoctrix,ualidior exiftit, aut debilior: aut ex eo quòd humores uel tenues sint, uel crasfi. Hi enim tardius, illi uero celerius ab ipsa uincuntur natura. Ridiculi quoque sunt nostri temporis nonnulli medici, qui summam ægrorum imbecillitatem, & uitæ discrimen silenti Lunę attribuunt. Primùm enim siue sileat Luna, siue illustrissima sit, interdiu tamen in hæc nostratia[?] nihil,aut imbecillimè agit. Intercipitur nanque uis eius à Sole, qui tũc agit maximè, terramq;, aquas, & aërem calefaciens & illustrans. Si præterea morbus est calidus & siccus, qua-lis solet esse omnis acutus, ipsa silens Luna, quæ tunc noctem ex accidenti refrige-rat & humectat, nullam ægri uiribus potest detrahere noxam: imò uerò potius ipsam naturam morbo oppressam leuat contrarijs qualitatibus, quas nocturno aëri induxit adversus istum morbum ex diametro pugnans.

page.notes: Doubtful: the first word "bi" has a partly cut first letter (possibly "si"). "nostratia" is uncertain at the line end. "quòd" is printed with a grave accent. Printing errors left as printed: "crasfi" (printed with long s, read as crassi-like form). Catchword "EXER-" and signature "E 2" are at the foot as printed.
